threat_event: Targeted intrusion on the business network (phished credentials, then hands-on-keyboard activity) that attempts to pivot toward Level 3 through the receive server, vendor paths, or portable media
threat_source: Nation-state or state-sponsored group targeting nuclear facilities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing domain administrators; flat server VLAN; unmanaged receive server management interface (R-052); no alert on attempts to reach boundary addresses
existing_controls: One-way deterministic device from Level 3 to Level 2; no remote access to Level 4; PMMD kiosks; EDR with 24x7 MSSP
treatment_plan: Boundary-attempt alerting; receive server hardening; server segmentation; privileged access management; joint IT and CST drill

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts WMS, the clearance module, CAP/EDMS, RWP, and file servers during a refueling outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Untested DR for WMS and CAP/EDMS; legacy clearance servers; flat server VLAN; standing domain administrators
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-06; SYS-10; BP-02; BP-03; BP-06
sp800_53_controls: CP-4; CP-10; CP-9; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
existing_controls: Immutable backups in a separate recovery account; EDR with 24x7 MSSP; MFA for remote access; paper clearance process
treatment_plan: WMS and CAP/EDMS failover tests before 2027-03-08; 15-minute clearance database log shipping; segmentation; privileged access management; outage ransomware tabletop
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$8M (about 1.5 days of outage extension at $2.03M a day, plus response)

threat_event: Ransomware on the business network while the unit is online
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same as R-002
existing_controls: Immutable backups; EDR; MFA; CSP isolation keeps generation running
treatment_plan: Same program as R-002

threat_event: Takeover of a domain administrator account used to deploy malware or disable security tools across the business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 16 standing domain administrators; push MFA (not phishing-resistant); no MFA on site console logons; administrators read email with admin accounts (3 of 14)
existing_controls: MFA for remote and cloud; EDR
treatment_plan: Privileged access management for directory, database, and WMS administrators; FIDO2 keys for administrators; remove vendor domain administrator accounts

threat_event: Attacker on any workstation reaches the WMS database and file servers directly because the server VLAN is flat
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Server VLAN shared by WMS, CAP/EDMS, historian replica, and file and print servers; workstations can reach database ports
existing_controls: Edge firewalls; EDR
treatment_plan: Segment server tiers with deny-by-default rules; move the receive server and historian replica to their own VLAN first

threat_event: A change made outside the CST process creates an unevaluated data path or dependency involving Level 3 data or EP functions, leading to a CSP noncompliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 changes since 2023 never evaluated (analytics feed, predictive maintenance gateway, ERO callout service); change tickets do not ask whether a change touches 73.54 scope
existing_controls: CST evaluates CDA modifications initiated by Engineering
treatment_plan: CST evaluates the 3 changes; CSP scope question added to every IT change ticket; quarterly CST review of IT changes

threat_event: ERO callout service outage or compromise delays staffing of the TSC, OSC, and EOF during an emergency
threat_source: Callout service vendor failure or attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS callout service never evaluated by the CST; printed call tree takes about 45 minutes
existing_controls: Printed call tree; dedicated EP phones at the EOF
treatment_plan: CST evaluation; quarterly test of the call tree; second callout path (SMS gateway from a different provider)

threat_event: Compromise of a vendor through its shared VPN account gives an attacker persistent access to the WMS and the business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 shared vendor VPN accounts always enabled; no session recording; no interconnection terms
existing_controls: VPN with MFA for workforce; EDR on servers
treatment_plan: Named, time-limited vendor accounts through the privileged access broker with recording; interconnection terms

threat_event: Malicious communications through the dispatch RTU vendor remote access go undetected, and the company is found noncompliant with CIP-003-9 Section 6.3
threat_source: Supply chain attacker; NERC compliance audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No method to detect known or suspected malicious inbound and outbound communications for vendor electronic remote access (effective 2026-04-01)
existing_controls: Methods to determine and disable vendor remote access (Sections 6.1 and 6.2)
treatment_plan: Deploy an intrusion detection sensor on the dispatch network vendor path; document the method; evaluate self-report with the Compliance and GRC Lead

threat_event: WMS and the clearance module cannot be recovered within the BIA RTOs after a major failure
threat_source: Hardware failure, ransomware, or site data center event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot-light DR never failover-tested; clearance module cannot run in the DR environment; daily backups against a 15-minute RPO
existing_controls: Immutable backups; paper clearance process
treatment_plan: Failover test 2026-11-14; database log shipping every 15 minutes; clearance module upgrade

threat_event: CAP is unavailable and a 73.77(b) 24-hour recordable event is not recorded on time
threat_source: CAP outage during a cyber event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written manual CAP fallback
existing_controls: CAP coordinators available 24x7 during outages
treatment_plan: Paper CAP intake procedure with sequential numbers; add to P08 runbooks; drill

threat_event: An attack on WMS, EDMS, CAP, or the receive server is not detected in time because their logs are not monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Application and receive server logs not in the SIEM; no alert on boundary-address attempts; no egress alerting in the cloud
existing_controls: SIEM on identity, VPN, firewall, EDR, and cloud logs
treatment_plan: Onboard the 4 sources; boundary-attempt and egress use cases; monthly use-case review with the CST

threat_event: During a cyber event the IT team and the CST act separately, and a 73.77 notification is late or the Shift Manager is not told
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate IT and CSP incident plans; last joint drill 2024-02; IT plan does not call the CST or the Shift Manager
existing_controls: CSP incident response; Shift Manager trained on 73.77
treatment_plan: Integrated P08 runbooks; joint tabletop 2026-11-05; Shift Manager decision aid exercised with IT

threat_event: A business IT vendor is breached and its access or data is used against the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 210 vendors with access; business IT vendors reviewed only at onboarding; 9 of 24 Tier 1 without current assurance
existing_controls: Contract confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Vendor tiering; annual Tier 1 SOC 2 review (P09); security addenda

threat_event: Security-Related Information on general shares is read or exfiltrated by someone without need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SRI-marked documents found on general engineering shares; no DLP; annual review of restricted folders
existing_controls: EDMS restricted folders; SRI marking procedure
treatment_plan: Search and move SRI; sensitivity labels with DLP; quarterly restricted folder review

threat_event: Safeguards Information is disclosed without authorization by an insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Residual risk only: stand-alone computers, locked containers, need-to-know, and FBI checks are in place
existing_controls: SGI program; 73.56 access authorization; stand-alone computers
treatment_plan: Accepted within appetite: controls met in P03; covered by the insider runbook (P08)

threat_event: IT administrators of systems that support EP functions take harmful actions without having been through access authorization
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EOF LAN and ERO callout administrators are not in the 73.56 program because those systems were never evaluated
existing_controls: HR screening at hire
treatment_plan: Decide scope after the CST evaluation; enroll administrators in the program or move administration to enrolled staff

threat_event: Exploitation of the out-of-support clearance servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Windows Server 2012 R2 with SMBv1 for tag printers; vendor supports only that version until the 2027 upgrade
existing_controls: Extended security updates; EDR
treatment_plan: Isolate on a dedicated VLAN; disable SMBv1 with print server change; upgrade after the outage

threat_event: Clearance status is wrong in the WMS (software fault or tampering), and a worker relies on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No integrity monitoring of clearance records; daily backups only
existing_controls: Field verification of every tag by a second qualified person; separation of duties
treatment_plan: Integrity checks on clearance tables; 15-minute log shipping; paper clearance drill

threat_event: The predictive maintenance gateway becomes an unmanaged path into the balance-of-plant equipment network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor gateway installed without CST review; own cellular link; read-only access claimed, not verified
existing_controls: Gateway sensors are clamp-on and wireless, not wired to the DCS (vendor statement)
treatment_plan: CST evaluation; verify no connection to CDAs; remove cellular link or route through the business network edge

threat_event: The predictive maintenance model misses a developing failure on a balance-of-plant pump, leading to an unplanned derate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot model trained mostly on fossil plant fleets; recall below target for feedwater heater drains (P10)
existing_controls: Time-based preventive maintenance continues unchanged
treatment_plan: Monthly performance review; retraining on site data; no deferral of preventive maintenance

threat_event: Staff paste Security-Related Information or plant details into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list until the P06 policy; no web filtering for AI sites
existing_controls: Annual training on SRI
treatment_plan: Approved enterprise assistant (AI-002) with data protections; block public AI tools; training update

threat_event: The applicant tracking AI ranking feature disadvantages applicants in a protected class
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature enabled by vendor default; no bias testing; no human review rule
existing_controls: Recruiters review all applications today (not documented)
treatment_plan: Disable ranking until reviewed; adverse impact analysis; written human review rule (P10)

threat_event: The CAP screening assistant under-classifies a condition report, and a significant condition is not escalated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot assistant suggests significance levels; screeners may over-rely on suggestions
existing_controls: Human screening committee decides every classification
treatment_plan: Suggestions hidden for security-related reports; monthly agreement audit (P10)

threat_event: Price forecast errors lead to poor schedules and imbalance charges
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor model with limited visibility into features
existing_controls: Traders review every schedule
treatment_plan: Accepted: low impact under fixed-price PPAs

threat_event: An unapproved change to GDSR scripts reports wrong hourly generation or attribute data to the buyers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Meter-data scripts edited directly; no second reviewer; no check on manual adjustments
existing_controls: Monthly reconciliation to revenue meters
treatment_plan: Change control with second reviewer; adjustment logging and review; SOC 2 readiness

threat_event: GDSR is unavailable for more than 3 days and data is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single region for GDSR
existing_controls: Backups; spreadsheet fallback
treatment_plan: Accepted: $10,000 a day credit and manual fallback are tolerable

threat_event: The company cannot deliver a clean SOC 2 Type 2 report for 2027 and breaches PPA-2
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Informal GDSR controls; change management and access reviews not evidenced
existing_controls: None yet
treatment_plan: Readiness plan in P09; Type 1 by 2027-03-31; observation period from 2027-04-01

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment change requests sometimes approved by email
existing_controls: MFA; email filtering; callback rule for new vendors
treatment_plan: Callback verification for every bank detail change; dual approval above $50,000

threat_event: Breach of access authorization records (background checks, fitness-for-duty results)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enclave is on the business network; administrators are domain administrators
existing_controls: Restricted VLAN; named access list
treatment_plan: Dedicated administrator accounts for the enclave; monitoring; segmentation from the domain administrator tier

threat_event: The HR and payroll SaaS vendor is breached and employee personal information is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor assurance not reviewed since onboarding
existing_controls: Contract requires breach notice
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review; 10-day notice term confirmed

threat_event: The cloud identity provider has an outage and staff cannot sign in to SaaS and cloud applications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity provider; break-glass only for cloud consoles
existing_controls: On-premises directory still serves WMS and CAP
treatment_plan: Break-glass accounts for productivity suite and ERP; outage procedure

threat_event: A cloud regional outage takes down GDSR and analytics and delays restores from the recovery account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workloads in one region; recovery account in a second region
existing_controls: Recovery account in a second region
treatment_plan: Accepted: low impact processes; MTD 72 hours

threat_event: A contractor laptop or USB drive introduces malware to a low-impact BES Cyber System
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Evidence of malware checks missing for 3 of 12 sampled vendor laptops (CIP-003-9 Section 5.2)
existing_controls: Transient cyber asset plan; scanning kiosk
treatment_plan: Kiosk log as evidence for every connection; contractor briefing; quarterly evidence check

threat_event: Portable media or a business laptop is moved from Level 2 into Level 3 or 4 outside the PMMD process
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 20 sampled rugged tablets lacked the Level 2 label
existing_controls: PMMD kiosks; CSP procedures; CDA port controls
treatment_plan: Label all tablets; add PMMD rules to contractor training; spot checks during the outage

threat_event: The one-way device fails or is misconfigured and plant data stops flowing to Level 2 or appears corrupted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single device; no integrity check on received data
existing_controls: Hardware one-way device; CST monitors device health
treatment_plan: Accepted: Level 3 operations are unaffected; replica backfills

threat_event: The MSSP misses or delays escalation of a high-severity alert, or its platform is compromised
threat_source: MSSP failure or supply chain attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP monitors only what it receives; escalation tested informally
existing_controls: Contract requires a call within 30 minutes; monthly reports
treatment_plan: Quarterly escalation tests; MSSP SOC 2 review; add the CST to the escalation path

threat_event: Outage contractor accounts stay active after the outage and are later misused
threat_source: Former contractor or attacker using stale credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 25 sampled outage contractor accounts still enabled 30 days after the 2025 outage
existing_controls: Inactivity disablement after 45 days
treatment_plan: End date on every outage account; disable on demobilization; reconciliation within 5 days of outage end

threat_event: Terminated or transferred staff keep access to WMS roles or local server accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transfers keep prior WMS roles (5 of 25); local accounts not removed (2 of 25 terminations); annual reviews
existing_controls: HR-driven disablement in the identity provider
treatment_plan: Automated role removal on transfer; local account sweep; quarterly reviews

threat_event: A laptop with SRI is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Residual only; full-disk encryption verified
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes disclosure unlikely

threat_event: Internet service disruption at the Station cuts cloud and SaaS access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual carriers at the Station
existing_controls: Dual carriers; carrier DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accepted: dual carriers and on-premises WMS and CAP

threat_event: Exploitation of a known vulnerability in the internet-facing VPN appliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge appliance patched within 30 days; known-exploited vulnerabilities not fast-tracked
existing_controls: Quarterly scans; MFA on the VPN
treatment_plan: Known-exploited vulnerability patching within 72 hours for edge devices; weekly advisory review

threat_event: Server configuration drift leaves weak settings that an attacker uses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No server baselines; 4 of 10 servers below 70% of benchmark
existing_controls: Workstation group policy
treatment_plan: Issue STD-01; benchmark scans monthly

threat_event: EOF business LAN loses its single internet circuit during an emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single circuit at the EOF; EP phones are separate
existing_controls: Dedicated EP phones; cellular hotspots
treatment_plan: Second carrier or cellular failover router at the EOF

threat_event: Outage contractors with a 20-minute training module mishandle SRI or portable media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor module does not cover SRI or PMMD rules
existing_controls: Contractor module; supervisor briefings
treatment_plan: Add SRI and PMMD content before the 2027 outage

threat_event: Someone plugs a rogue device into the EOF network room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EOF network room uses a keyed lock; no network access control on wired ports
existing_controls: EOF building alarm
treatment_plan: Badge reader on the EOF network room; port security

threat_event: Ransomware remains hidden longer than the 35-day backup retention and corrupts EDMS records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 35-day write-once retention; no monthly long-term copy of EDMS
existing_controls: Write-once backups
treatment_plan: Monthly long-term EDMS copies kept 1 year

threat_event: The NRC changes 73.54, 73.77, or RG 5.71 and the program must be reworked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed rule published 2026-06-26 (not final)
existing_controls: Regulatory Affairs tracks rulemaking
treatment_plan: Accepted: monitor; act only when final

threat_event: CIRCIA becomes final and adds a CISA reporting duty that the runbooks do not include
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Runbooks list CIRCIA as proposed only
existing_controls: Regulatory Affairs tracks rulemaking
treatment_plan: Review the final rule within 30 days of publication and update P08

threat_event: A departing engineer copies SRI or design information to personal storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DLP; USB storage allowed on business laptops
existing_controls: Exit interview; access removal at termination
treatment_plan: DLP for SRI labels; USB storage blocked by default; exit review of downloads

threat_event: An attacker who reaches the cloud identity and security account tries to delete backups and logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud administrators use push MFA; break-glass not yet tested
existing_controls: Write-once backups and logs; separate backup credentials
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for cloud administrators; quarterly break-glass test

threat_event: The receive server management interface (found in P07 with default credentials) is used to tamper with the receive server
threat_source: Any adversary on the business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unmanaged server management interface on the server VLAN with the manufacturer default password
existing_controls: Interface disconnected 2026-08-14 after the assessors reported it
treatment_plan: Keep the interface disconnected; move to a management VLAN with a unique password; inventory all management interfaces
